plan.interpretation: Pair discrimination and full-scene detection are separate metrics; only same-scene v17/v18 results are directly comparable

task: Same full synthetic scenes, frozen100v17proposals, one reference; no oracle crop inputs

own_initialization.kind: Own synthetic-only v17 initialization, not third-party pretrained weights

proposal_stage.score: Uncalibrated learned center logit; no confidence prefilter
proposal_stage.boxes: Original-image absolute xyxy pixels, half-open; clipped to image bounds
proposal_stage.preprocessing: Aspect-preserving resize, median-border RGB padding; query never upscaled
proposal_stage.support_coordinates: Predicted foreground logit>0 extent; detached integer crop; minimum4 descriptor cells per axis; empty mask falls back to full reference
proposal_stage.input_supervision: One supplied reference RGB and query RGB only; no masks, boxes, text or labels

ranker.loss: 0.5 positive logistic +0.25 near-negative logistic +0.25 wrong-support logistic

provenance.ranking_score: Class-balanced conditional-match logit; no score fusion or confidence prefilter
provenance.region_input: Frozen v17 proposed box, floor/ceil original pixels, aspect-preserving96px median-border letterbox
provenance.cache: Original-image integer crop key; query patch descriptors reused across references
